title: Phishing Awareness
what: Deceptive messages that try to steal credentials or money.
why: It is the top entry point for incidents.
warning_signs: Urgency, look-alike domains, unexpected attachments/QR codes.
safe_practices: Verify via a trusted channel; hover to inspect links.
if_it_happens: Do not click; report to IT/security; change passwords if you entered them.

title: Password Security
why: Reuse turns one breach into many.
safe_practices: Use a password manager and long passphrases.
if_it_happens: Change the password and enable MFA.

title: MFA & Passkeys
what: Extra proof of identity beyond a password; passkeys/WebAuthn resist phishing.
safe_practices: Prefer app/passkey over SMS; never share codes.
if_it_happens: Deny unexpected prompts and reset credentials.

title: Safe Browsing
safe_practices: Type known URLs; keep browsers updated.
if_it_happens: Close the tab and run a trusted scan.

title: Ransomware Awareness
what: Malware that disrupts access and may threaten data leaks (defensive overview).
safe_practices: Backups, patching, least privilege, MFA, segmentation.
if_it_happens: Disconnect from the network and call incident response.

title: Incident Reporting
what: Telling security quickly when something looks wrong.
if_it_happens: Report immediately with details; no blame.
